panel.species: exact final SDM-admissible species_order frozen in the response-blind LGM relation artifact
panel.sources: exact source_species frozen in that relation artifact
panel.targets: exact target_species frozen in that relation artifact

sequence_and_distance.sequence_pair_distance: uncorrected p-distance over jointly canonical A/C/G/T columns
sequence_and_distance.locality_pair_distance: arithmetic mean over all valid cross-locality sequence pairs

post_ibd_response.ibd: endpoint-safe leave-two-localities-out rank IBD inherited from the validated relational estimator
post_ibd_response.source_training_response: post-IBD turnover rank orthogonalized against edge-length rank

pairwise_transfer.output: one T_st value for every frozen source x target dyad in the relation artifact

primary_model.inference: two-way source/target cluster-robust one-sided primary test

existing_outcome_boundary.allowed_claim: prospectively specified secondary dyadic comparative-phylogeographic test on an existing genetic source

interpretation.positive: Within the frozen Palearctic terrestrial-insect secondary panel, higher overlap of independently reconstructed LGM climatic suitability geography predicts greater source-to-target transferability of post-IBD spatial genetic differentiation after declared present-climate, geographic, taxonomic and sampling controls.
interpretation.null_with_qualification: The frozen LGM climatic-refugial opportunity relation does not detectably explain source-target transfer heterogeneity in this selected panel under the qualified effect domain.
interpretation.not_evaluable: No biological conclusion; do not compute the subpanel genetic response when TTF-Q qualification fails.
